principle: Every quantity a decision reads must have been observable at or before the decision instant, and no future mutation may change a historical decision.

time_semantics.bar_open_time_ms: provider kline field 0 (epoch ms, UTC), the bar's start, carried in the projection as `t`
time_semantics.bar_close_time_ms: provider kline field 6 (epoch ms, UTC), the bar's end, carried as `ct`
time_semantics.bar_span: [bar_open_time_ms, bar_close_time_ms]; for 5m bars close = open + 299999 ms
time_semantics.decision_time_ms: max(close_time of the leader bar at slot t, close_time of the follower bar at slot t) - the first instant at which the complete ARC-02 signal is knowable
time_semantics.entry_time_ms: the open_time_ms of the entry bar (leader and follower slots are aligned on the same 5m grid)
time_semantics.exit_time_ms: the open_time_ms of the exit bar (= entry_time_ms + 300000)
time_semantics.funding_time_ms: the settlement instant of a certified funding row (== availability_time_ms == settlement_time_ms)

clauses.name: btc_current_bar_completed
clauses.statement: The leader bar read by a decision satisfies bar_close_time_ms <= decision_time_ms.
clauses.enforcement: the decision is taken at the bar's close; the forming bar is invisible

clauses.name: follower_current_bar_completed
clauses.statement: The follower bar read by a decision satisfies bar_close_time_ms <= decision_time_ms.
clauses.enforcement: decision_time_ms is the MAXIMUM of the two close times, so neither bar can be read before it closes

clauses.name: btc_lookback_contains_only_bars_at_or_before_decision
clauses.statement: The 288 trailing leader return references are formed from bars whose close times are all <= decision_time_ms.
clauses.enforcement: references are t - j*300000 for j = 1..288, each closing at least 5 minutes before the decision

clauses.name: follower_response_contains_no_future_bar
clauses.statement: The follower response is the log return of the SAME completed slot as the leader bar; no later follower bar is consulted.
clauses.enforcement: r_f(t) uses only follower bars at t and t-300000

clauses.name: entry_strictly_after_decision
clauses.statement: entry_time_ms > decision_time_ms; same-bar entry is impossible.
clauses.enforcement: entry is the OPEN of the first follower bar with open_time_ms > decision_time_ms

clauses.name: exit_anchor_causal
clauses.statement: The exit bar is identified by clock arithmetic only (entry_time_ms + 300000); no forward price or outcome information enters signal eligibility.
clauses.enforcement: the only forward question asked is 'does the exit bar exist inside the admitted partition'; the exit PRICE is never inspected to decide whether to trade

clauses.name: funding_window_disjoint_from_signal_window
clauses.statement: Funding settlements are read only within (entry_time_ms, exit_time_ms], which is strictly after decision_time_ms; funding is never a signal input.
clauses.enforcement: the funding module is not importable from the signal evaluation path; the signal record contains no funding field

clauses.name: future_mutation_invariance
clauses.statement: Mutating any bar with bar_open_time_ms > decision_time_ms leaves the emitted direction, the reason code and the feature values at decision_time_ms unchanged.
clauses.enforcement: the evaluation reads a bounded, purely trailing window

clauses.name: past_eligible_mutation_detectable
clauses.statement: Mutating an eligible reference bar (inside the 288-bar trailing set) or the driver basis can change the shock statistic and the emitted direction.
clauses.enforcement: the battery is non-vacuous: a test that could not change anything would prove nothing

clauses.name: missing_btc_bar_fails_closed
clauses.statement: A missing leader bar (current slot, driver basis, or any of the 288 references) fails the decision closed with LEADER_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE / BAR_ALIGNMENT_FAILURE.
clauses.enforcement: no interpolation, no forward-fill, no synthesis, no partial-window admission

clauses.name: missing_follower_bar_fails_closed
clauses.statement: A missing follower bar fails the decision closed with FOLLOWER_BAR_MISSING.

clauses.name: conflicting_duplicates_fail_closed
clauses.statement: A partition containing a duplicate bar-open slot raises CONFLICTING_OR_DUPLICATE_SLOT and fails closed rather than picking a winner.
clauses.enforcement: load_partition() raises; the authority has zero duplicates by construction

clauses.name: future_htf_or_context_invisible
clauses.statement: No higher-timeframe label, regime label, cross-asset index, open-interest value, order-book value or funding value is readable by the signal.
clauses.enforcement: the projection carries only t/ct/o/c; the evaluation reads only completed close prices

clauses.name: forward_price_guard_is_clock_only_censoring
clauses.statement: A decision whose entry bar or exit bar would fall outside the admitted partition or beyond end_ms is dropped with NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA. This is structural clock censoring over whether a complete outcome can exist - no knowledge of the outcome itself.
clauses.enforcement: the last two 5m slots of the common window therefore emit no trades

clauses.name: no_unadmitted_field
clauses.statement: No field other than open, close (and close_time as the completion anchor) is read by the signal.

fail_closed_policy: any violation of a clause above is a NO_SIGNAL (fail closed) at the decision level, and an INFRASTRUCTURE_FAIL at the execution level if it arises from a broken authority rather than from missing data
violation_classification: a PIT violation recorded during execution is INFRASTRUCTURE_FAIL, never a strategy failure
